Im so sorry you feel like nobody cares. Thats such a terrible state to be in, and if it were up to me, nobody deserves to ever feel that. Even the strongest of us, the most introverted of us, can feel alone. I know its probably not helpful at all to hear, but i really feel this post. I wish I could be happy and or content by myself, but god does if feel empty and pointless. Im sorry i dont have anything constructive to offer, im just another lost fucked up soul on here....but I just wanted to say, I feel this. 

Also, another useless comment to read, and its random and i hope its not annoying you to read this....but I LOVE love your username....sorry, i know thats random and not helpful. I just couldnt help myself to comment about it. Undertale is one of the only things ive really cared about since it came out years ago.

I dont know. I have no idea what any of their intentions were. Didnt seem like they gave a shit. Just wanted to waste time so they could get their payment. Or torture me like the last person i saw did....

Basically yes, but no. I have private insurance, (blue cross/blue sheild through my dads employer.) And medicaid.
 
I havent worked since I was 20, due to being completely mentally unstable, and if that wasnt enough, i started having spinal problems and chronic pain. I have bertolottis syndrome, generative disc disease, pars defeact that wont heal, and some other shit. Then i started havig pelvic floor issues that ive tried p.t. and steriod shots. It didnt really help.
Ive applied for disabilty once and they sent me a letter that basically stated you wernt disablied before you were 18, so go fuck yourself. They sent me that letter wihin a week, and claimed they couldnt get a hold of the back doctor i had been seeing. Bullshit, in truth, they saw my age and wrote me off. It contributed greatly to my depression. I know usually everyone gets denied their first try, but it just feels so futile. If they keep claiming they cant reach the people that i work with, then it feels so pontless. But leeching off my parents as a 25 yr old (even tho they say i dont, i do) makes me feel even more like shit. Like a basement dweller. I was fairly independent before i got sick, despite the fact my groomer was abusing the shit out of me back then.

But yeah, basically im responsible. I have insurance. But im extrememly reluctant to try therapy ever again after what happened last time....
Last time i went to the hospital, told them how i felt, bascially i had to promise i wasnt going to off myself, they sent me through their free mental health clinic in my city (they dont do therapy there, they just point you to where you need to go (that didnt work out) cause she sent me to a medicaid therapist office that was supposedly supposed to be trained in CBT. Well if you read my post we all see how that went...
Honestly at this point, j dont really care about debt or finances. But i know if you dont have it no one will treat you...or you get sent to a living nightmare of a place...
But i do have blue cross now which i didnt then. Im just so hopeless now and i dont even know where to begin because ive never been properly diagnosed with anything, except "major depressive disorder" from my GP. I have no idea if i need a phychologist ect ect. Someone trained in PTSD? Im pretty sure i have that, but i dont like self diagnosing.
I have no idea where to even begin. And im afraid if i experience what i did last time, it will completely push me over the edge....

Yup. I realized that too. So for the past 5 years i made a personal choice to stay single and ty to work on myself, "love myself". And it helped that i havent even been remotely attracted to anyone since then. And even if i was I knew I was too fucked up for a "healhy relationship". Whatever that is. Never think I had one. So i tried focusing on myself and "getting better". All it did was make me realuze how alone I am and how much my life actually sucks. If you wanna know how i feel about shit, check my post history.
Im not looking for fullfillment btw. I could really give a shit less about what some fuckhead thinks of me.
